cases.name: one page is already the end

hints: If you can reach page 6, can you reach page 4?
Greedy: track the farthest reachable page.
Scan left to right; if i is past the farthest reachable page, return false; otherwise extend farthest to max(farthest, i + jumps[i]).

signals: States that the reachable pages always form a prefix
Gives O(n) time and O(1) space
followups: Return the fewest clicks to reach the last page.
Links may also go backward. Does the greedy still work?
Why is "always take the biggest jump" wrong for fewest clicks?
